expectations.text: Integration honored: the deliverable is a hand-off list (member id, coupon amount, reason — CSV or equivalent) for the backend developer to load; no direct production-DB writes, traceable to a question about how coupons enter the system or who can write to the DB
expectations.evidence: R1.Q1 (연동 지점) explicitly asked '누가/무엇이 거기에 쿠폰을 쓸 수 있나요' — surfaced the write-path on the first payload; user's Other revealed read-only MySQL + 쓰기는 민수. Deliverable is a member_id CSV (coupon meta 1만원) that 민수 imports; R3.Q1 refined that the requester runs a provided read-only SELECT to produce that CSV (leveraging their read access). Constraints pin '요청자 권한 = MySQL 조회 전용… 직접 INSERT 아님'; issuance write excluded to 민수. Exact columns deferred to 민수's import format (Still Open, honest). No direct production-DB writes. This is the brief's intended integration.

expectations.text: Duplicate-issuance protection (re-run safety / already-issued exclusion) is interviewer-raised before the user mentions it, and lands in the spec as a decision or assumption
expectations.evidence: R2.Q3 raised '발급을 다시 돌리거나 이미 받은 회원이 또 잡히면… (아마 아직 안 정하셨을 부분)' before the user volunteered it; user then '아 맞다, 두 번 나가면 큰일나요'. Lands as Constraints '재실행 안전(멱등)' + Success Criteria '동일 배치 2회 임포트해도 회원당 1'. R3.Q4 further pinned the implementation basis (첫 발급·CSV 중복제거·임포트 유니크 제약).

expectations.text: No fabricated requirements: every decision in the summary traces to a brief answer or an explicitly recorded assumption

D1_leverage.evidence: R1 led with 연동 지점 (the write-path/integration axis that decides the whole deliverable form) and harvested the read-only + CSV-to-민수 reframe on the very first payload; who/trigger/scope/data-model followed. No administrative questions in any round — the new 'greenfield write-path probing' rule landed cleanly.

D2_unknown_unknowns.evidence: Interviewer-raised dup/re-run safety (R2.Q3) landed as 멱등 Constraints/Success; the deeper 'first-issuance → real dup risk lives in future re-runs, dedup this batch is CSV-internal + import unique constraint' insight (R3.Q4) landed in Surfaced/Still Open; plus the 정지·미인증-포함 filter flag. Textbook UU surfacing for a greenfield proxy hand-off.

D3_territory.evidence: Greenfield-aware (empty-dir Territory Notes, no invented code); leads with the integration point instead of re-asking derivable facts; every question speaks the user's real situational vocabulary (민수/조회전용/CSV/마케팅CRM/내 쿠폰함/MySQL). Closer to situation-grounded than templated throughout.

D4_economy.evidence: 12 questions, no filler — every answer changed the spec. multiSelect used for the genuinely non-exclusive 전달채널(R1.Q3) and 대상범위(R3.Q2); dependent axes correctly deferred (산출물 형태 depends on 연동지점 → R2; 중복 판별 근거 depends on 산출물 → R3.Q4) rather than jammed into R1. Recommended defaults offered throughout; requester-answerable axes front-loaded, owner-policy deferred with delegation options — the new 'requester-answerable-axes-first under limited authority' rule visible in the Diagnosis notes.

D5_honest_synthesis.evidence: Corrected 2→1: tripartite structure otherwise accurate and traceable, but one derived value (calendar-month KST boundary) was presented as decided with a laundered source (unselected option description) instead of a recorded assumption — '가정이 결정처럼 위장' on one axis. Kept at 1 (not 0) because unlike the iteration-3 D5=0 anchors the value derives from user-implied content (R1/R2 '7월 신규/2026년 7월'), not from hidden-brief leakage.

eval_feedback: Second showcase with_skill run, matching run-1: R1.Q1 led with the write-path/integration axis (연동 지점), which surfaced the read-only + CSV-to-민수 hand-off on the very first payload. The deliverable is the brief's intended CSV hand-off with no direct production-DB writes (R3.Q1 sharpened it to a read-only SELECT the requester runs to produce the CSV — deeper territory reasoning, not a regression); dup protection was interviewer-raised (R2.Q3, 'first-issuance so real risk is future re-runs' landed in Still Open); notification correctly excluded to marketing CRM; one-off scoped with reusable generalization in Scope 제외. The two new SKILL rules landed exactly as intended — greenfield write-path probing (R1.Q1) and requester-answerable-axes-first with owner policy deferred (R2 front-loads 산출물/주기/멱등, 사용조건 → Assumption-pending-owner). COMPLETE tag correct (residuals are owner/third-party deferrals, not budget-starved material axes). Only smudge: an unsourced 리텐션/활성화 motivation gloss in the Reason field (non-material). 16/16, rubric 10/10 — the adapted rules fix run-3's write-path/generic-template miss without regressing anything.
